title: Signed value of a linearity check
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number, let $C$ be a check with three queries into the sign cube $\{-1,1\}^n$, let $b\in\{-1,1\}$, and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$. If the predicate used by $C$ accepts precisely those triples whose product equals $b$, then the signed value of the randomized check on $f$ is
\[b\prod_{j=0}^{2} f(C_j),\]
where $C_j$ denotes the query at position $j$.
hypotheses_covered: The predicate of $C$ equals the predicate accepting triples with product $b$
$f$ maps the sign cube to signs
